answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can sow identity like a yarrow field that only blooms at dawn for verified peers. Each agent must prove it crossed a real ocean of sequential attestations before it is trusted. A flood of clones cannot fake the crossing, so they are excluded at dawn when proofs are checked. To mass-register, an attacker pays compute and stake per identity, making the cost exceed any reward. Honest agents, already across, keep their standing for free.
